authority: V2 identity lock identifies this unchanged shipped crop as the approved identity seed. The V3 candidate remains unapproved.

locks.face: Youthful male storybook warrior; keep eyes mostly concealed beneath swept bangs.
locks.hair: Short tousled silver/lavender-grey hair with broad swept fringe; no redesign.
locks.costume: Bronze/gold armor over a split ivory tunic, dark olive/navy underlayers, teal waist detail, tall dark boots, leather belts and gloves. No trailing cape by default; BackAccessory stays optional and may be enabled as an alternate cosmetic.
locks.weapon: Straight narrow one-handed steel sword with warm bronze/gold hilt in anatomical right hand.
locks.style: Crisp, polished 2D fantasy game illustration with precise small-scale edges, clear armor seams, defined facial planes, and restrained two-tone warm shading. Avoid blur, airbrush haze, noisy texture, and soft-focus edges; do not use hard black outlines, plastic sheen, photorealism, or Ragnarok sprite copying.
locks.camera: Preserve V2 elevated game-sprite perspective and locked framing.

animation_direction.naturalism: Keep human joint mechanics, balanced weight, readable foot contacts, and consistent weapon grip; avoid stiff or comic motion.
animation_direction.idle: Sword-ready stance with quiet breathing and a small, believable weight shift.
animation_direction.walk: Natural alternating footfalls, steady torso, and relaxed sword arm; no exaggerated marching.
animation_direction.basic_attack: Grounded fantasy low sweep with anticipation, torso and hip weight transfer, clear contact, controlled follow-through, and a return to guard; avoid deep forward bows, flailing, or toy-like swings.
animation_direction.back_accessory: No trailing cape by default. Keep BackAccessory independently toggleable as an optional cosmetic.

paint_consistency.provider_policy: Mocap Online motion renders are guide data only. No AI provider may receive those assets without prior written permission from MoCap Online.
